name: Cube Composer
tagline: Race a friend from one link. Line up the cubes. Progress lives in the file.
description:
Press Play a friend, then Invite in the bar above the app, and send the link. You both get the same picture. First to match it wins. No account, no install — the race is the invite, and your progress lives in the file.

On your own it is Cube Composer. You have a row of coloured cubes and a picture of how they should look. Tap a function to add it, tap it again to take it out, drag to change the order. Watch the cubes change with each step. Six short chapters; skip around if you like.

You never see each other's functions — only who finished, and how many steps they used.

An unofficial port of Cube Composer by David Peter. The puzzles, the cubes and the functions are his.
